Now I see something interesting. At line 648:
```c
td.data = gnutls_malloc(str_size + 1);
```

If `str_size` is 0 (because the OCTET STRING has 0 length), then `td.data = gnutls_malloc(1)`. This allocates 1 byte of uninitialized memory. Then at line 652:
```c
memcpy(td.data, str, str_size);
```

If `str_size` is 0, `memcpy` copies 0 bytes. Then at line 653:
```c
td.data[str_size] = 0;
```

This sets `td.data[0] = 0`. So the data is null-terminated. This is fine.
